sources.title: 34MB Kodachrome LoRA for MOSS Image trained… · AGI Hunt
sources.snippet: Reddit user aoleg77 released a Kodachrome-style LoRA for MOSS Image on Hugging Face: a factor-16 LoKR of just 34MB, trained on 551 scans of 4x5 Kodachrome sheet film (not 35mm, so no film grain).

sources.title: MOSS-Image | Text-to-Image Generation with Native Layout Control
sources.snippet: MOSS-Image is a text-to-image model family from OpenMOSS, comprising a base model and a curated-data fine-tuned model. In addition to natural-language prompts, MOSS-Image supports native text-driven layout generation: objects, rendered text, and their spatial positions can be specified in a JSON prompt.

sources.title: MOSS Image Generator & AI Photo Editor | MossImage
sources.snippet: Try MOSS-Image, then box any part of your picture, say what to change and get a clean new version. AI photo editing for product listings, ads and social posts.
